note.question: How should management of virtual infrastructures under flexible cloud service agreements be designed?
note.overview: Cloud-service agreements entail the provisioning of virtual infrastructures at specified availability levels. The agreements specify the infrastructure prices and penalties borne by providers when assured availabilities are not met. Hence, backup resources should be optimally provisioned by balancing the provisioning costs with penalties.
